title: Terraform module for VPC observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL, log shipping) with upgrade hooks and health checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Private (VPC) customers need a single, maintainable Terraform module that provisions a full observability stack tailored for air-gapped/VPC deployments: Prometheus (operator-based), Grafana (dashboards + provisioning), an OpenTelemetry Collector (OTEL) with managed pipelines, and a pluggable log shipping component.

Scope: Build an opinionated, reusable Terraform module that: provisions k8s resources (Helm provider or Kubernetes manifests), exposes health & readiness probes, includes lifecycle/upgrade hooks (pre-apply validations, canary rollouts, post-upgrade checks), supports optional Vector or Fluent Bit for log shipping, and emits module outputs consumable by Redwood Console (endpoints, dashboard URLs, alert rules). The module must be configurable for retention, scraping intervals, S3-compatible remote write for long-term metrics, and KMS-encrypted secrets for collector credentials.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement Console ingestion pipelines or user-facing Console UI changes; it focuses on the IAC and in-cluster health/upgrade plumbing.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Terraform module (registry-style) that can be instantiated in a sample VPC overlay and provisions Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL collector, and a log shipper.
2) Module exposes outputs: prometheus_endpoint, grafana_url, otel_metrics_endpoint, log_shipper_endpoint, dashboard_manifest_url.
3) Health checks: liveness/readiness endpoints for OTEL + Prometheus operator; module wires Kubernetes PodDisruptionBudgets and readiness/liveness probes.
4) Upgrade hooks: pre-upgrade dry-run validations, staged canary rollout option, and post-upgrade smoke tests automated via terraform null_resource -> remote-exec (or provider-native equivalent).
5) Documentation: README with variables, examples (default, air-gapped, high-retention), and migration notes for existing customers.
6) Integration test: a small k8s cluster test harness (kind or AWS EKS-lite) that runs module apply/destroy and verifies metrics scrape and logs shipping at least once.
7) Security checklist completed and sign-off from Security.
implementation_notes:
- Use Terraform 1.6+ and keep module inputs minimal but extensible (map variables for component overrides).
- Prefer Helm provider for operator/chart installs; fallback to kubernetes_manifest for air-gapped installs.
- Provide a 'canary' boolean and 'canary_fraction' to control rolling updates for deployments (e.g., OTEL collector).
- Implement null_resource hooks for preflight checks: cluster API access, CRD presence, and storage connectivity (S3/KMS).
- Health checks: configure Prometheus operator ServiceMonitors for collector and shippers; expose /ready and /live where possible.
- Log shipper: default to Vector with option to choose Fluent Bit. Provide TLS and mTLS config variables.
- Outputs: export structured JSON string for dashboards so Console can fetch and provision.
- Provide a variable to toggle 'remote_write' to a configured S3-compatible endpoint for long-term metrics; include sample retention policy.
- Add feature flags for 'air_gapped' to load images from private registry and skip external calls.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 - Prototype (this ticket): implement module and example overlay in test cluster; run integration tests.
Phase 2 - Canary customers: enable for 2 low-risk Private customers behind feature flag; monitor SLOs for 2 weeks.
Phase 3 - GA: publish module to internal registry and update onboarding templates; enable automated upgrade path documented in README.
Rollback: module will support rollbacks through Helm revision restore and terraform state rollback guidance. Preflight validations prevent unsafe upgrades.
test_plan:
- Unit: terraform fmt/check, static validation, and module unit tests (terragrunt/terratest where applicable).
- Integration: run an automated scenario that deploys module to an ephemeral EKS cluster, verifies: Prometheus scrape targets include the collector, Grafana is reachable and contains provisioned dashboards, logs from sample app arrive at the shipped sink.
- Upgrade test: perform simulated upgrade with canary_fraction 10%; confirm pre-upgrade checks pass and post-upgrade smoke tests succeed.
- Failure injection: simulate remote_write unavailable and confirm graceful degradation (local TSDB retained, alerts fired).
risks_mitigation:
- Risk: Air-gapped installs may fail due to image availability. Mitigation: document private registry workflow and include helm chart tarball support.
- Risk: Upgrades cause downtime. Mitigation: enforce PDBs, readiness probes, and canary rollout policy; run preflight validation.
- Risk: Secrets misconfiguration. Mitigation: require KMS-backed secrets by default and include clear secret rotation steps.
- Risk: Cost explosion from retention. Mitigation: expose retention variables with sane defaults and include cost guidance in README.
progress_updates: 2026-02-15: Initial module skeleton committed (infra/observability/module). Created example overlay for eks-dev.
2026-02-22: Proof-of-concept: Helm-based Prometheus operator + Grafana provisioning works in kind cluster. Added OTEL collector helm chart and basic pipeline.
2026-02-28: Implemented preflight null_resource checks (CRDs, storage connectivity). Opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123
2026-03-04: Integration tests green on CI (kind). Discovered a timing issue with CRD installs; added explicit CRD wait step.
review_comments: PM (Lina Roberts): Ensure dashboard URLs are stable across upgrades and include a dashboard version output for Console mapping.
Security (Rajiv Shah): Require KMS-enforced encryption for any credentials and add a policy for minimal IAM permissions. Recommend threat model for log shipping endpoints.
Design (Marta Gomez): Request a sample Grafana provisioning JSON for default dashboards and an option to opt-out of provisioning.
